content: BullMQ: delivery is effectively at-least-once; failed jobs retried via attempts with fixed/exponential backoff (+jitter); worker crash mid-job flags job stalled, requeued and reprocessed by another worker while the original may still be running (double-processing risk); maxStalledCount bounds stall reassignment before moving to failed; worker.close() waits for in-flight jobs (no internal timeout) and ungraceful kills rely on stalled recovery; Queue.pause() is global, Worker.pause() local, in-flight jobs not interrupted.
